items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: He used to play at E. Lala's, E. Lala's Nightclub, yeah.

ctx.x: I already made some in California about 1921. I guess you left right before. I was gone. I think Fred Washington was on that.
Do you remember Fred Washington? Yeah, I left. Did you know I'm down here? Fred Washington, yeah. He used to play at E. Lala's, E. Lala's Nightclub, yeah. He played with a band or a solo?
No, he was a band. They had a band.
